name: ynab-mcp
description: A custom MCP server for YNAB (You Need A Budget) — view budgets, categorize and approve transactions, search, and reporting

tools.name: hello
tools.description: Says hello back, to confirm the YNAB MCP server is connected and working.

tools.name: list_budgets
tools.description: Lists all YNAB budgets available to this account.

tools.name: get_ready_to_assign
tools.description: Gets the current 'Ready to Assign' amount for a budget.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Lists the open accounts in a budget with their current balances.

tools.name: list_all_account_balances
tools.description: Lists account balances across every budget, grouped by budget.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists category groups and categories in a budget, with balances.

tools.name: move_money_between_categories
tools.description: Moves budgeted money from one category to another within the same month.

tools.name: list_uncategorized_transactions
tools.description: Lists transactions that don't yet have a category assigned.

tools.name: list_unapproved_transactions
tools.description: Lists transactions that haven't been approved yet.

tools.name: approve_transaction
tools.description: Marks a transaction as approved.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Searches transactions by payee, category, account, and/or date range.

tools.name: suggest_category
tools.description: Suggests a category for a transaction based on the payee's categorization history and the transaction amount.

tools.name: bulk_suggest_categories
tools.description: Suggests categories for every uncategorized transaction at once, as a review list.

tools.name: categorize_transaction
tools.description: Assigns a category to a specific transaction.

tools.name: split_transaction
tools.description: Splits a transaction across multiple categories with different amounts.

tools.name: create_category_group
tools.description: Creates a new category group in a budget.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Creates a new category within an existing category group.

tools.name: spending_by_category
tools.description: Reports total spending per category over a date range.

tools.name: get_month_summary
tools.description: Financial snapshot for a budget month: income, budgeted, spent, age of money.

tools.name: list_overspent_categories
tools.description: Lists categories that have been overspent this month.

access_token.title: YNAB Personal Access Token
access_token.description: Generate one in YNAB under Account Settings → Developer Settings → New Token.
